item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Xi or the Chinese state materially protected independent journalism, editorial autonomy, or uncensored public access to information. The closest “positive” items were government-run disclosure portals and Hong Kong government statements defending press freedom, but both are self-reported and do not show independence in practice.","evidence":[{"title":"Press freedom in HK protected","publisher":"Hong Kong SAR Government / news.gov.hk","date":"2024-09-10","url":"https://sc.news.gov.hk/TuniS/www.news.gov.hk/eng/2024/09/20240910/20240910_171518_986.html","summary":"Officially claims Hong Kong citizens retain press and speech freedoms, and that journalists may criticize government so long as they do not violate the law. This is self-justification, not independent evidence of media protection.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3"]},{"title":"国家档案局政府信息公开工作2024年度报告","publisher":"National Archives Administration of China","date":"2025-02-13","url":"https://www.saac.gov.cn/daj/xxgk/202502/67d628e9c74043389492dba14f6f3cb1.shtml","summary":"Reports 1,952 items proactively disclosed in 2024, 14 access requests handled, and 477 in-person users served. This shows a bureaucratic information-access channel, but not an independent media environment.","question_ids":["4B.6"]},{"title":"China: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/china/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Says China has one of the world’s most restrictive media environments and a sophisticated censorship system, with direct party control, accreditation, directives, website blocks, app removal, and mass deletions. Also says the government increasingly controls information diffusion and shapes public discourse.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3"]},{"title":"RFA closes Hong Kong bureau after passage of new security law","publisher":"Radio Free Asia","date":"2024-03-29","url":"https://www.rfa.org/english/news/china/rfa-bureau-closure-03292024133320.html/","summary":"Says Article 23 raised safety concerns enough that RFA closed its Hong Kong bureau, ending one of the last independent reporting presences there.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3"]},{"title":"Journalists dismiss official claims of press freedom in Hong Kong","publisher":"Radio Free Asia","date":"2024-05-07","url":"https://www.rfa.org/english/news/china/hong-kong-press-freedom-05072024131034.html","summary":"Reports journalists and RSF calling official press-freedom claims unconvincing, citing an “unprecedented campaign against independent journalism,” closures of eight outlets, prosecutions, and use of articles as court evidence.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3"]},{"title":"关于开展“清朗·整治‘自媒体’无底线博流量”专项行动的通知","publisher":"Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission Office / CAC","date":"2024-04-23","url":"https://www.cac.gov.cn/2024-04/23/c_1715545670217049.htm","summary":"Orders real-name verification, source labeling, AI labeling, traffic throttling, comment/like suspension, and account closures for “self-media.” This is a direct censorship/disinformation-control campaign, not protection of information access.","question_ids":["4B.6"]}]}
